title: The Privilege of Exposure: Caste and Generative AI in India’s Graduate Labour Market

bias_targets.methodology: Mapping three occupational AI-exposure indices (ability-based, task-based, and generative-AI automation scores) to India's Periodic Labour Force Survey and calculating the standard deviation differences in AI exposure across Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, and upper-caste graduates.
Comparing occupational AI exposure indices between male and female graduates and using linear regression to estimate both gender main effects and caste-gender interaction effects.

Splitting the graduate labor force sample into discrete age cohorts (15-30, 31-45, 46-65) and comparing occupational AI exposure gaps to evaluate how technological privilege varies across different generations of workers.
